newsitem.title: USA: US chain store sales up 0.1 pct - BTM/Schroders.
newsitem.headline: US chain store sales up 0.1 pct - BTM/Schroders.

text.p: U.S. chain store sales rose 0.1 percent in the week ended October 26 from the prior week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales index.
Sales for the week were up 4.4 percent on a year-over-year basis, while the month-to-date index was unchanged from the prior month.
"Store sales were mixed relative to plan with department stores softer for the week while mass merchandisers were generally stronger," a BTM/Schroder report said.
